about: !story: the same story as different traditions tell it. Each passage is a reference the bot can look up and a quotation from it (tests/test_stories.py checks both against the loaded text); the excerpt shown starts at the quotation. 'read_by' gives the Christian writers who read a pagan passage as pointing to Christ, checked the same way.

flood.title: The Flood
flood.intro: A god or gods send a flood to wipe out humanity, and one good man (with his family) survives in a boat to begin the world again. Some form of this story is told almost everywhere.

passages.title: Noah's ark
passages.quote: And the flood was forty days upon the earth
